mechanics.description: Common items roll no affixes. Uncommon and Rare rolls are constrained by the rarity limits below, the base item's prefix and suffix capacities, compatible pools and modifier groups. Candidate eligibility never guarantees a particular roll.
mechanics.title: Rarity and affixes

mechanics.description: The candidate list applies item type, item tier, pool tier cap, prefix and suffix capacity, local base-stat restrictions and weapon damage type. Existing modifier groups and rarity still constrain an actual item.
mechanics.title: Compatible modifiers

mechanics.description: Each class starts at its own free origin. A class entry can connect through that origin. Ordinary adjacency needs a connected neighbor; an all-neighbor cross path needs every neighbor. Nodes without adjacency use all listed prerequisites.
mechanics.title: Connected talent paths

mechanics.description: Spend one matching material per attempt. Levels +1 through +3 are guaranteed; later attempts succeed with a 70% chance. Ordinary failure resets the item to +0; blessed failure preserves its level. Affixes are preserved. Weapons use stones; armor and shields use tablets. Jewelry and consumables cannot be enhanced.
mechanics.title: Enhancing equipment

mechanics.description: Reforge spends the listed currencies to lock one random unlocked affix. It does not reroll affixes. Price grows with the count already locked; the engraved forge keystone halves the rounded price, rounding upward. The displayed eligibility predicate and action checks are listed separately.
mechanics.title: Locking affixes with Reforge

mechanics.description: Each node supplies its own allocation cost; the current costs by kind are listed below. Class origins are free. Allocation spends talent points; legacy skill points are used only when the talent-point balance is zero or negative. Refund orb costs are a separate rule.
mechanics.title: Talent allocation costs

mechanics.description: Enemy abilities use the exported effect, parameters, resource cost, cooldown and damage-over-time fields. Self-buffs affect their caster; enemy debuffs affect the hero. Both also strike. Healing restores the caster without a basic strike. Logical ticks last 0.5 seconds; ordinary meter telegraphs count speed-dependent action-meter fills.
mechanics.title: Enemy ability mechanics

data.description: A grotesque hybrid of flesh and alchemical apparatus, still wired to the laboratory's ruined systems. The artificer's final project, sealed in the lowest vault when it would not stop growing — the seal held for forty years; the door did not survive the collapse.
